label: digit 2 input early in the original phase
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase (never on <DEL> or copy steps), mostly on the input token 2 (68% of activation mass, 21x lift), and concentrated in positions t=0..3, falling off sharply after t=4. Weaker activations occur on other inputs (h, 0, l, g, y, w) in the same early positions. The strongest activations are on a first-occurrence 2 at t=2-3 that follows letters such as f, x, o, d, m (e.g. f x o [2]); a 2 at t=0 fires reliably but weakly (~0.09 of max). Many 2s go inactive, especially later in the sequence or after other preceding letters (w, b, n, k, i), and repeat occurrences of 2 rarely fire. The predicate gets about 0.57 precision and 0.60 recall on dev; the missed mass is the other-token early-position activations.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=0: 2; t=1: 2, h, 0, l; t=2: 2, h, 0, l) and the first original token (most: f, o, m, z, x, t; least: y, w, b, g); timing cues that raise it most: t=3, t=2, L=8 & t=4.
